messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, real, usable local Windows app (Arabic RTL UI) that imports student rosters from PDF, stores them in local JSON, lets the user search/select absent students by name, exports a 5-column Excel file matching the Sharqia Directorate attendance template, and automates importing that Excel into the directorate's website via Playwright (with verification, no blind retries, manual fallback).

## Requirements
- Full Arabic spec (sections 1–16): local-only data (no cloud), JSON DB files (`data/students.json`, `schools.json`, `classes.json`, `attendance.json`, `settings.json`, `import_history.json`), React+TS+Vite frontend, RTL Arabic UI, Lucide icons, Playwright automation, PDF extraction, XLSX export.
- Excel columns exactly and only: A `كود الطالب`, B `الصف`, C `اسم الطالب`, D `الفصل`, E `عدد أيام الغياب` (= always `1`); one sheet; no extra sheets/columns.
- Scope: مديري التربية والتعليم بالشرقية / إدارة `غرب` / مدرسة `فصول ملحقة بنايوس الثانوية المشتركة`; extensible.
- Student codes stored as strings (never numeric); incomplete records require explicit confirmation before export.
- Safe JSON writes (temp + atomic replace), backups, no deletion on re-import, conflict review, no concurrent unsafe writes, no credentials in JSON/logs.
- No fake/demo data in final files/dashboard; tests use synthetic data only; never claim site import success without verified indicators; never bypass CAPTCHA; never auto-resubmit on unknown/pending results.
- Final report must cover: files created/edited, tests passed, working features, remaining user-required steps.

## Decisions
- **Python not installed** → Node.js backend (v26.10.0, npm 11.19.1).
- PDF tooling: `pdfjs-dist@4` (legacy build) + `pdf-lib` + `@napi-rs/canvas`; XLSX via `exceljs`.
- Automation via `playwright-core` driving a system browser (`channel: 'msedge'`/`'chrome'`) — no browser download.
- **No OCR needed**; decoding fully solved (empty ToUnicode + Identity-H → GID → embedded-font cmap reverse map → visual→logical reversal → NFKC + Persian/Urdu normalization).
- 11 unmapped Segoe UI GIDs shipped in `data/glyph_overrides.json` as `byGid` (font+GID) + `byHash` (SHA-1 of glyf bytes); all verified visually by rendering outlines large, then matching to the printed row.
- GSUB-parsing approach attempted and abandoned.
- Header parse labels anchored at cell start; label right / value left; value may follow `:` or `=` in same cell.
- Class field mapping: `grade` → Excel `الصف`; `section` → Excel `الفصل`; `className` = section.
- Cell text ordering: Arabic-containing cells → ascending-x then reverse visual→logical; no-Arabic → descending-x unless all parts pure digits (ascending).
- **Zero-width (w≈0) PDF text items are ESSENTIAL** — they carry the FINAL LETTER of names. Must NOT be dropped; `PDF_DROP_ZERO_WIDTH` experiment reverted.
- `ok` in automation result means only `status === 'success'`.
- Headless default: `headless = !!settings.headless` (visible browser for manual fallback).
- `APP_DATA_DIR` / `APP_EXPORT_DIR` env overrides so tests never touch real user data.
- **Student codes are never merged into a name**: `isCodeItem()` in `pdfExtractor.mjs` forces a cell boundary around any standalone 6–12-digit item (fixes two-students-per-row mispairing).
- **Safety rule**: if one physical row yields more than one record, ALL its records are flagged `needsReview` rather than silently exporting a truncated name.
- Class display label field is `name` (not `label`) in `data/classes.json`; students use `classLabel`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project at `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب`; `npm install` succeeded; `docs/API.md` authoritative, port 5199.
- Frontend complete (`npx tsc --noEmit` exit 0, `dist/index.html` + `assets/` present, SPA served at root).
- `server/db.mjs`: atomic write, per-file lock, backups (keep 20), `uid`, `log`, env-overridable dirs.
- `server/store.mjs`: data layer; re-exports `ROOT, DATA_DIR, BACKUP_DIR, EXPORT_DIR, EVIDENCE_DIR`; strips credentials on save.
- `server/pdfExtractor.mjs`: works; `visualToLogical` exported; trace modes `PDF_TRACE` (`ALL`, `NOCODE`, cell pattern), `PDF_TRACE=ITEMS` (+`PDF_TRACE_Y0/Y1`), `PDF_TRACE_UNMAPPED`, `PDF_DEBUG_DROP`; `isCodeItem` boundary fix; `physKey`-based safety flagging.
- `server/excel.mjs`: exactly 5 columns, 1 sheet, code as Text (`numFmt='@'`), days=1, RTL frozen header, sanitized names, `verifyWorkbook()`.
- `server/automation.mjs`: honest statuses (`success|partial|needs_manual|blocked_captcha|missing_url|error`), CAPTCHA detection, screenshots to `data/evidence/`, single labeled submit click, manual handoff, `closeManualBrowser()`.
- `server/index.mjs`: full Express API per docs + serves `dist/` with SPA fallback.
- `server/importRoster.mjs`, `server/validateRosters.mjs`, `server/seedGlyphOverrides.mjs`, `server/repairNames.mjs`, `server/repairPairing.mjs`.
- **Glyph decoding 100% complete**: 11 GIDs (3941 ا, 3948 س, 3950 ش, 3951 ش, 3970 ص, 3971 ص, 3972 ض, 3981 ل, 3992 ر, 4011 ى, 4012 ي); `unmapped = 0` on all 4 real PDFs; 8 FFFD names repaired (مرسى، ماضى، مرسى، موسى، بشرى، ناصر...).
- **Row-pairing bug fixed**: recovered missing student `474605836`, corrected `474641789` → «سما محمد سمير احمد خليل», removed 1 codeless duplicate; 178/183 rows unchanged.
- Real DB final state: **183 students** — 1/1=52, 1/2=51, 1/3=41, 1/4=39; **0** corrupt names, **0** duplicate names, **0** missing metadata, **3** codeless, **9** `needs_review`.
- All diagnostics deleted (`server/_*.mjs`, `_*.txt`); `exports/` empty; `attendance.json` empty; `data/evidence/` empty.
- **All 15 tests pass** (`npm test`): `tests/excel.test.mjs` (4), `tests/extractor.test.mjs` (5), `tests/api.test.mjs` (6).
- Real end-to-end export verified: 1 sheet, exactly 5 columns in order, code as `string`, `الصف`=`الأول`, `الفصل`=`1 / 4`, days=`1`, `verified: true`; test artifacts cleaned up.
- UI verified in browser: dashboard (183 طلاب، 4 أصناف، آخر استيراد 2026/10/28، Excel متحقق منه، 0 غائبين)، Students page (183 نتيجة، 100 معروضة، كود كنص، زر تعديل)، Attendance page (تبويبات 1/1–1/4، قائمة طلاب، ملخّص).
- `README.md` updated (11 glyphs، 9 سجلات مراجعة بنوعيها، `repairPairing.mjs` بالأوامر)؛ `start.bat`، `setup.bat` موجودة.

### Active
- (none) — implementation and verification are complete.

### Blocked
- Directorate site URL/behavior not obtained — automation returns honest `missing_url`; **no selectors may be assumed** until the user supplies the URL.
- No known-good Excel template supplied — `الصف`/`الفصل` mapping must be verified by the user against a real successful file.

## Next Move
1. Await the user's directorate site URL (and any previously-successful Excel template) before writing any automation selectors.
2. After receiving the URL: write real selectors, run a supervised automation pass, and verify success indicators before declaring success.
3. If the user reports any of the 9 flagged records, correct them via the Students screen (or re-run `node server/repairPairing.mjs <pdfs>`).
4. Restart the server if needed: `node server/index.mjs` (port 5199); `npm test` for regression.

## Relevant Files
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\server\pdfExtractor.mjs`: core extractor; `isCodeItem`, safety flagging, trace modes.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\server\index.mjs`: Express API + static serving (main entry, port 5199).
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\server\excel.mjs`: 5-column workbook builder + `verifyWorkbook`.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\server\automation.mjs`: Playwright automation with honest statuses.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\server\store.mjs` / `server\db.mjs`: JSON store, atomic writes, backups, env dir overrides.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\server\repairPairing.mjs`: reconciliation — name repair, review-flag sync, dedup, class-metadata backfill.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\server\repairNames.mjs`: repairs names stored with `\uFFFD`.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\data\glyph_overrides.json`: 11 verified GID→char mappings.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\data\students.json`: 183 students, 9 `needs_review`.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\tests\{helpers,api,excel,extractor}.test.mjs`: 15 passing synthetic tests.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\README.md`: Arabic user docs incl. remaining user steps.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\غياب\docs\API.md`: authoritative API contract.
- `C:\Users\cw\Downloads\تقرير قوائم الفصول (85…88).pdf`: real source rosters (already imported).
- `C:\Users\cw\Temp\pdfprobe\`: glyph/row renderers (`render.mjs`, `words.mjs`, `big2.mjs`) for visual ground truth.

## Important Context
- Environment: Windows, **no Python/pip**, Node v26.10.0 + npm 11.19.1; Edge at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe`, Chrome at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe`.
- Workspace is now a git repo (per env), but **no commit/push has been performed** — all work is uncommitted.
- PowerShell console mangles RTL — write extraction output to files (`Out-File -Encoding UTF8`) and read with `Get-Content`.
- `node -e` with inline ESM `import()` or complex Unicode often hangs/times out in this shell — prefer writing a temporary `.mjs` script file and running `node server/_x.mjs`.
- Row clustering: y-gap threshold 8, x-gap > 9 splits cells, whitespace-only items dropped; name-group merge gap ≤ 14.
- Each PDF page has **two students per physical row** (right group code ≈ x475, left group code ≈ x190; row numbers at x≈545 and x≈262).
- Unresolved glyphs would emit `\uFFFD`; currently none remain.
